name: Frame by frame in the player (Bookmarks 1.4.0 / 2.2.0) on Frame Counter (2023) (H.264 MP4 at 25 fps, played directly; Initialize-Sandbox.ps1 -PlayerTracks adds it). Every frame of the video carries its number as a 12-bit code, read back through a canvas, so each step is proved to show exactly the next or the previous frame, paused, with the position in the middle of it: . while playing, . and , (three quick presses all counted), the two player buttons and a held key; then Adjust on 'Frames R' (0:04-0:06) from the player's Bookmarks list: the start shown, stepped with the keys in the bar, Right and Enter to Set start here and to Save, the saved start exactly 3 frames later (read back, and shown again when adjusted again), Escape saving nothing; then at phone width (375 px, mobile layout) the frame buttons and the bar inside the screen with 40 px buttons, a tap to step, Set start here and Cancel saving nothing. Screenshots: frames-player-desktop, frames-adjust-desktop, frames-player-phone and frames-adjust-phone. As admin; the video's bookmarks reset first and deleted at the end.

steps.name: find Frame Counter (2023)
steps.eval: (async () => { const r = await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Frame Counter', Limit: 10 }); const m = r.Items.find(i => i.Name === 'Frame Counter (2023)'); if (!m) throw new Error('Frame Counter (2023) is not in the library: Initialize-Sandbox.ps1 -PlayerTracks adds it'); return m.Id; })()

steps.name: its video stream's frame rate
steps.eval: (async () => { const it = await ApiClient.getItem(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), __vars.movieId); const v = it.MediaSources[0].MediaStreams.find(s => s.Type === 'Video'); return { real: v.RealFrameRate, average: v.AverageFrameRate, codec: v.Codec }; })()

steps.name: reset its bookmarks to 'Frames P' (a point at 0:02) and 'Frames R' (the range 0:04-0:06)
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movieId; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } for (const body of [{ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 20000000, Name: 'Frames P' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 40000000, EndTicks: 60000000, Name: 'Frames R' }]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))).map(b => b.Name + ' ' + b.StartTicks + (b.EndTicks ? '-' + b.EndTicks : ''));

steps.name: details page with a Play button
the frame reader: each frame of the video carries its number as a 12-bit code in its top band (white is 1, bit 0 on the left), read through a canvas
steps.eval: (window.__fc = { video: () => document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'), fps: 25, no: () => { const v = window.__fc.video(); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 640; c.height = 360; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(v, 0, 0, 640, 360); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, 640, 60).data; let n = 0; for (let b = 0; b < 12; b++) { const x = Math.floor((b + 0.5) * 640 / 12); if (d[(30 * 640 + x) * 4] > 128) n |= 1 << b; } return n; }, settled: () => { const v = window.__fc.video(); return !!v && v.paused && !v.seeking && v.readyState >= 2; }, at: () => { const f = window.__fc.video().currentTime * window.__fc.fps; const k = Math.floor(f + 1e-6); return { frame: k, offMiddle: Math.abs(f - k - 0.5) }; } }, true)

steps.name: played as DirectPlay
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const s = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Sessions', { deviceId: ApiClient.deviceId() })); const p = s[0] && s[0].PlayState; return !!p && p.PlayMethod === 'DirectPlay'; })()
